rationale: C19 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. It addresses the same immediate Formosa Strait crisis and contains the child’s distinctive factual theory: Communist military action against Quemoy, the announced objective of taking Taiwan/Formosa together with the offshore islands, the characterization of United States forces as resisting rather than committing aggression, and the preference for negotiation and renunciation of force. The child adapts this material to answer Senator Green’s four objections and adds the specific congressional-authority analysis. C22 is the next strongest because it supplies closely parallel arguments about constitutional war authority, collective defense, and strength deterring aggression, but it lacks the crisis-specific factual material. C04 shares the peace-through-firmness and resistance-to-aggression framework, though in a different regional controversy.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Chinese and Soviet Communist leaders assert... that if they can take Quemoy and Matsu by armed assault that will open the way for them to take formosa and the Pescadores
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The official Peiping radio has repeatedly been announcing that the purpose of these military operations is to take Taiwan (formosa) as well as Quemoy and Matsu, by armed force.
shared_material.explanation: This is a distinctive, crisis-specific factual proposition linking an assault on the offshore islands to the announced objective of taking Formosa/Taiwan.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the only way the United States could become involved in hostilities would be because of its firm stand against Communist attempts to gain their declared aims by force
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The issue, then, is whether the Chinese Communists will seek to achieve their ambitions through the application of force... United States military forces... are there to help resist aggression—not to commit aggression.
shared_material.explanation: Both texts use the same justificatory machinery: Communist pursuit of territorial aims by force makes any United States military role defensive resistance to aggression.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am striving to the best of my ability to avoid hostilities; to achieve a cease-fire, and a reasonable adjustment of the situation.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The United States hopes that an understanding can be achieved through the renewed talks which will assure that there will be no resort to the use of force
shared_material.explanation: Both pair firmness against aggression with an immediate negotiating objective aimed at preventing force and peacefully adjusting the dispute.
